xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
I. In Annexure 1 - Composition of Board of Directors for the question "Whether Chairperson is related to MD or CEO" we have mentioned 'Yes' since our Chairperson, Mr. Subhadip Dutta Choudhury, is also the Managing Director and CEO of the Company.
II. Composition of Board of Directors:
Sr. No. 5: Mrs. Susan M. Vasudeva, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, had attained the age of 75 years on August 25, 2023. A special resolution under Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI Listing Regulations was duly passed for the continuance of her Directorship, elegible to retire by rotation, at the 63rd AGM held on August 9, 2023. A special resolution was thereafter again passed at the 64th AGM held on August 5, 2024, for re-appointing Mrs. Vasudeva, who was retiring by rotation at the said AGM.
Sr. No. 6: Mr. Ravi Kant was first appointed as an Additional Director of the Company with effect from June 1, 2016, to hold office up to the 56th AGM which was held on August 4, 2016. He was duly appointed as an Independent Director under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, with effect from August 4, 2016, for a term of five consecutive years. As required by the Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, effective from April 1, 2019, a special resolution was duly passed at the Annual General Meeting held on August 7, 2018, for continuance of his Directorship with effect from June 1, 2019, as he would have then attained the age of seventy-five years, up to the end of his first term on August 3, 2021. He was duly reappointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years with effect from August 4, 2021, by a special resolution duly passed at the AGM held on July 29, 2021. The tenure of Mr. Ravi Kant (in months) is counted from the date of his appointment as an Independent Director by the shareholders under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, i.e., with effect from August 4, 2016, as is also specified in Regulation 25(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
Sr. No. 7: Prof. Leena Chatterjee was first appointed as an Additional Director of the Company with effect from April 1, 2019, to hold office up to the 59th AGM which was held on August 6, 2019. She was duly appointed as an Independent Director under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, with effect from August 6, 2019, for a first term of five consecutive years. The tenure of Prof. Leena Chatterjee (in months) is counted from the date of her appointment as an Independent Director by the shareholders under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, i.e., with effect from August 6, 2019, as is also specified in Regulation 25 (2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. She was duly reappointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years with effect from August 6, 2024, by a special resolution duly passed at the AGM held on August 5, 2024.
Sr. No. 8: Mr. Murli Aildas Teckchandani has been duly appointed as an Independent Director of the Company under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, with effect from August 1, 2021, for a first term of five consecutive years. As required by the Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, a special resolution was duly passed at the Annual General Meeting held on August 4, 2022, for continuance of his Directorship with effect from October 19, 2022, as he would then attain the age of seventy-five years, up to the end of his first term on July 31, 2026.
Sr. No. 9: Mr. Shyamak Ramyar Tata has been duly appointed as an Independent Director of the Company under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, with effect from February 1, 2024, for a first term of five consecutive years by a Special Resolution duly passed by the shareholders through Postal Ballot, by e-voting only, on January 25, 2024.
Sr. No. 10: Mr. Sanjay Khatau Asher has been duly appointed as an Independent Director of the Company under Section 149 of the Companies Act, 2013, with effect from February 1, 2024, for a first term of five consecutive years by a Special Resolution duly passed by the shareholders through Postal Ballot, by e-voting only, on January 25, 2024.
